QUOTE: With `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off, the header maps `mbedtls_calloc` straight to `calloc` at compile time.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that with the platform memory option off (the default), mbedtls_calloc and mbedtls_free are macros mapping directly to calloc/free, with no runtime indirection. The diagram shows the same: "MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY off ──► calloc / free (platform.h:163-168, macros)".
